initialIssues.stage: restart preflight after first successful inference
initialIssues.problem: CUDA memory was not yet reclaimed after process exit; immediate start rejected below 16000 MiB
initialIssues.resolution: Bounded 60-second GPU wait, same memory threshold; final start passed. GPU wait during final recorded run was 0.045s, so this final record alone does not demonstrate a long wait path.

initialIssues.problem: During process exit cmdline became empty before proc disappeared, strict repeated command identity check reported mismatch
initialIssues.resolution: Strict identity check before SIGTERM; after signal wait only on matching original process start ticks; final after-inference stop/start and inference passed.
